info.name: Orders completed past one or more production steps

params.name: stepIds
params.description: Set of production step ids

items.docs: For each given production step id, finds candidate orders (those containing requisitions ever associated with the step) and returns the subset whose every active balance, across every requisition in the order, sits at a production status with a sequence strictly greater than that step's status sequence. The response is the union across all supplied step ids.

info.name: Get batch balances by status IDs

params.name: operationIds
params.description: Set of operation IDs to retrieve batch balances for

params.name: archived
params.description: Include archived requisitions

params.name: completedAfter
params.description: Only return balances completed at or after this instant (inclusive). ISO-8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z. Omit to apply no lower bound.

params.name: completedBefore
params.description: Only return balances completed strictly before this instant (exclusive keyset cursor). ISO-8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z. Omit to apply no upper bound.

params.name: completedBeforeId
params.description: Step ID of the oldest loaded balance, paired with completedBefore as the keyset tiebreaker so rows sharing the boundary completion instant are not skipped.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of balances to return, newest completion first

items.docs: Retrieves batch balances for the specified production status IDs
